name: workspace-git
description: Build-only grouping for this plugin bundle's packages — declares no dependencies of its own. `pnpm run build` (from this directory, or `pnpm --filter workspace-git run build` from the root) builds every package below in the same host-then-client order the root's own `build` script uses: the client packages import the Typert `/remote` stub that only exists once the host packages' own tsdown pass has generated it.

scripts.build:client: tsc -b client-ui-file-editing client-ui-workspace-files client-ui-conversation-files client-ui-workspace-enhanced client-ui-conversation-enhanced && for d in client-ui-file-editing client-ui-workspace-files client-ui-conversation-files client-ui-workspace-enhanced client-ui-conversation-enhanced; do (cd "$d" && tsdown) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
